ValidationRule.description: Ensures that an agent has not selected a Yes value to 'Have All Defects Been Rectified' if all other fields have been selected as a Yes
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false), (RecordType.DeveloperName = "KYC_QA"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed"), OR( ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Defects_Rectified__c, "Yes" ), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Defects_Rectified__c, "Customer Has Failed to Respond" )), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_ID_Not_Picture__c , "Yes"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Customer_Photo_Modified__c , "Yes"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Security_Features__c , "Yes"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_ID_Legible__c , "Yes"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Customer_Details__c , "Yes"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Selfie_Comparison_Match__c , "Yes"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Middle_Initial__c , "Yes"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_PO_Box__c , "Yes"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Middle_Name__c , "Yes"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Address_Valid__c , "Yes"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You have selected that an error has been rectified in the individual's KYC or that the customer has failed to respond with documents but have not selected what metric has recorded an error. Please check all fields prior to case closure.
